atoms.text: Pedro, Grant and Tracy are in a reading group. They have to agree on a book to read together, but they can’t seem to choose. Pedro wants to read “Scout Ahead”, Grant wants to read “Speed Up”, and Tracy wants to read “Grey Space”. Pedro’s book is the longest with 26 pages. Grant’s book has 18 pages, and Tracy’s has 25.
